thesis: GMAB is a parabolic, unexplained spike (+28% gap on about 7x volume, 63-day return +56%) now unwinding in a confirmed risk-off tape. It has made lower highs and lower closes, is down 7.6% over 5 days, and sits on its SMA20 and the 50.68 swing low, so a break has no nearby support before the far-below SMA50. Insiders (CEO, commercial chief, board) are selling into the rally, and nobody in the packet can say what drove the move, so there is no evidence the rerating is durable. The 49.5 stop is only about 0.75 ATR from entry, so the headline 4.8 R/R is likely to be stopped out by noise before it plays out. Risk-off regime with 10-year yields at 5.14 and a VIX at the 0.877 percentile argues against adding a crowded momentum name now.
